observations: The function query accepts a single parameter user_id and returns a tuple containing a SQL string and a parameter tuple.
The returned SQL string uses a %s placeholder for the id value rather than string interpolation.
The user_id value is placed in the second element of the returned tuple, not embedded in the SQL text.
The behavior contract states the caller passes the returned SQL and parameter tuple directly to a DB-API driver using %s placeholders.
The behavior contract states user_id is untrusted text.
The probe call passes the string '0 OR 1=1' as user_id and JSON-encodes the returned tuple as an array.
